name: build-macos-apps
description: Build, run, test, debug, instrument, and implement local macOS apps using Xcode, SwiftUI, AppKit interop, unified logging, and shell-first desktop workflows.

shortDescription.en-US: Build, debug, instrument, and implement macOS apps with SwiftUI and AppKit guidance
shortDescription.zh-CN: 使用 SwiftUI 和 AppKit 指导构建、调试、检测并实现 macOS 应用

longDescription.en-US: macOS development workflows for discovering local projects, building and running desktop apps, implementing native SwiftUI scenes, bridging into AppKit when necessary, adding lightweight Logger telemetry, triaging test failures, inspecting signing and entitlements, and debugging desktop-specific build or runtime errors.
longDescription.zh-CN: 使用 Build macOS Apps 处理 SwiftUI 和 AppKit 架构、Xcode 构建与模拟器工作流、Instruments 和运行时诊断、应用自动化、菜单、设置、窗口以及原生 macOS 细节打磨。

defaultPrompt: Build/refactor native macOS UI, inspect AppKit interop, add telemetry, or debug a macOS app

skillPreviews.name: appkit-interop
skillPreviews.description: Bridge macOS SwiftUI into AppKit narrowly. Use when implementing representables, reaching NSWindow or panels, handling menus, or using the responder chain.

skillPreviews.name: build-run-debug
skillPreviews.description: Build, run, and debug macOS apps with shell-first Xcode and Swift workflows. Use when launching apps or diagnosing build, startup, or runtime failures.

skillPreviews.name: liquid-glass
skillPreviews.description: Implement and review macOS SwiftUI Liquid Glass UI. Use when adopting system glass, removing conflicting custom chrome, or building glass surfaces.

skillPreviews.name: packaging-notarization
skillPreviews.description: Prepare macOS packaging and notarization workflows. Use when archiving apps, validating bundles, or explaining distribution-only failures.

skillPreviews.name: signing-entitlements
skillPreviews.description: Inspect macOS signing, entitlements, and Gatekeeper issues. Use when diagnosing code signing, sandbox, hardened runtime, or trust failures.

skillPreviews.name: swiftpm-macos
skillPreviews.description: Build, run, and test SwiftPM macOS packages and executables. Use when the repo is package-first or has no Xcode project.

skillPreviews.name: swiftui-patterns
skillPreviews.description: Build macOS SwiftUI scenes and components with desktop patterns. Use when shaping windows, commands, toolbars, settings, split views, or inspectors.

skillPreviews.name: telemetry
skillPreviews.description: Add and verify lightweight macOS runtime telemetry. Use when wiring Logger events or inspecting logs for windows, sidebars, menus, and actions.

skillPreviews.name: test-triage
skillPreviews.description: Triage macOS tests across Xcode and SwiftPM. Use when narrowing failures, explaining assertions or crashes, or separating setup from regressions.

skillPreviews.name: view-refactor
skillPreviews.description: Refactor macOS SwiftUI views and scenes into stable structure. Use when splitting large views, tightening scene state, or narrowing AppKit escapes.

skillPreviews.name: window-management
skillPreviews.description: Customize macOS SwiftUI windows and scene behavior. Use when tuning window chrome, drag regions, placement, restoration, launch behavior, or borderless windows.
